name: Gaddock Teeg
description: A Kinsbaile figure who meets Colfenor and plays political intrigues with Nath.

description_citations.text: "Colfenor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling takes a messenger job from Colfenor, gains the Vendilion clique and Brigid Baeli as companions at Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Ashling had accepted a seemingly innocuous messenger job from the treefolk sage Colfenor

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gaddock Teeg assigns Brigid to accompany Ashling in finding the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys.
timeline.quote: Brigid became embroiled in an increasingly complex adventure when Gaddock Teeg assigned her to accompany a flamekin messenger named Ashling on her mission to find a Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys .

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to capture Rhys as a gift for the Gilt-Leaf commander Nath.
timeline.quote: Teeg ordered Brigid to capture Rhys and bring him back as a gift to Nath.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg dies in flames as Colfenor combusts, though Ashling is saved.
timeline.quote: as he would eventually be set ablaze and die as Colfenor dramatically combusted by way of his own machinations.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor meets Gaddock Teeg and retains Ashling to reach Rhys, while Oona's Vendilion clique spies on him.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Ashling with reaching his former apprentice, Rhys.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor learns Brigid was meant to capture Rhys and redirects her to abduct Ashling so as to end his own life.
timeline.quote: Colfenor covertly redirected Brigid to abduct Ashling instead.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath and Gryffid come to Kinsbaile to ambush Rhys, planning to annex it.
timeline.quote: Nath and Gryffid came to Kinsbaile in pursuit of Rhys

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: who served as the right-hand of Gaddock Teeg .

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A wise kithkin often quoted on giants and faeries.

pages_say.description: A key character in the Lorwyn set and a cenn of his tribe, depicted by Greg Staples as a powerful and serious kithkin.

citation.text: "First Week's Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: Leader of Kinsbaile who sends Ashling on her way.

citation.text: "Ashling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The kithkin leader of Kinsbaile whom Brigid served; he orders her to capture Rhys and dies when Colfenor combusts.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
